messages:
ana: observed a small surge in EU streaming billing after keepalive rollout. reconnects clustered around 02:44 UTC.

lee: any 5xx or network drops?

ana: edge 200s. pattern = server keepalive 120s, client resume timeout 75s -> client gives up and opens new connection while old session still alive. duplicate sessions briefly.

lee: logs: ```[02:43:50] proxy route=eu session=old123 keepalive=120 last_event=789
[02:44:06] client resume_timeout -> new_conn=new456
[02:44:07] billing charge session=new456 tokens=...```

ana: quick mitigations proposed: rollback keepalive to 30s in canary, or implement short server-side resume_hold (2s) that tells client to wait.

lee: prefer resume_hold behind flag + metric instrumentation first. also add lint to block deadtime > client_resume default during rollouts.

console-bot: created metric resume_conflict.count and dashboard tile -> https://console/redwood/dashboards/resume-conflict

ops-bot: rollback job queued for eu-proxy canary (job 78001).

ana: filing RDW-PLAT-1142 for resume_hold experiment and RDW-PLAT-1143 for lint rule. tagging @lee.

lee: good. small follow-up: SDKs should read `event: resume_hint` long-term.
